```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(readxl)

source('../../ccMeetTools.R')
boysVarsity <- read_excel('bccFinal.xlsx', sheet='boys5000') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
girlsVarsity <- read_excel('bccFinal.xlsx', sheet='girls5000') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
```

## Competition summary
The weather was cool. It was about 70 degrees at the start.

### D.H. Conley Athlete times
Only the varsity races were on Milesplit, so that's who I will report times for here.
```{r}
buildTeamTable(boysVarsity, "D. H. Conley", maxAth=7)
buildTeamTable(girlsVarsity, "D. H. Conley", maxAth=7)
```

### Boys
```{r}
scoreMeetSimp(boysVarsity, "BCC Pitt County Teams at New Bern HS")
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
mpp(boysVarsity, "BCC Pitt County Teams at New Bern HS")
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6.5
mtp(boysVarsity, "BCC Pitt County Teams at New Bern HS")
```
